messages:
Yara: heads up — I saw console showing another org's saved searches briefly during canary :eyes:
Yara: looks like the prefetch proxy returned a cached panel for org A when user from org B loaded the dashboard
Sam: can confirm, I just repro'd locally. steps:
Sam: 1) open dashboard as org 111
Sam: 2) trigger prefetch route /api/panel/42 -> returns rows for org 111
Sam: 3) switch to org 222 via quick-switch, hit same panel URL -> got org 111 rows
Sam: log excerpt:
Sam: ```
INFO prefetch proxy req_id=abc123 headers={"X-Org":"111","Cookie":"session=..."} cache_key="/api/panel/42"
INFO hit cache_key=/api/panel/42 returning cached payload org=111
INFO request from user org=222 served cached payload org=111
``` 
Maria: omg — cache key is path-only. we cache by URL but never include tenant header in key
Maria: that would explain the leak
Kevin: is this the proxy sidecar (prefetch) or the edge cache?
Sam: prefetch proxy in front of console server. edge cache not involved in my repro
Olga: was this part of the rollout we did this morning? any canary % changes?
Yara: yes, new prefetch optimization rolled to 20% at 14:30 and telemetry noise started rising around 14:40
deploy-bot: canary-ship:prefetch-opt v2 -> increased to 20% at 2026-03-21T14:30:12Z :warning:
deploy-bot: rollback:prefetch-opt -> initiated at 2026-03-21T15:01:04Z by @Kevin :white_check_mark:
Kevin: immediate mitigation = rollback (done), add assertion to proxy that cached response.org == request.org
Kevin: long term = include tenant id in cache key and add unit/integration tests
Maria: sample fix (pseudo):
Maria: ```js
// buildCacheKey(req)
const org = req.headers['x-org'] || req.user.orgId;
return `${org}:${req.method}:${req.url}`;
```
Sam: also need to audit all other caches (widget cache, prefetch aggregator, telemetry sampler) — might be more places
Olga: I'll run a quick grep for cache_key= usage in repo and open a PR if it's path-only
Olga: assigning to myself for the fix and tests
Yara: telemetry: I saw a spike in `console.prefetch.cache_hit_no_tenant` and a small uptick in `console.user_view_mismatch` — I filed ENG-7890 to track metrics
Kevin: add alert for anomalous cross-org view rate (>0.01%) until we have tenant-scoped caching
Maria: we should also add a QA test that simulates org switch under rapid prefetch to catch regressions
Sam: note: request-level headers sometimes come from session cookie, sometimes from edge header. need normalized tenant extraction function
Maria: agreed. unify in middleware: getTenant(req) -> prefer header, fallback to session, error if ambiguous
Olga: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/prefetch/pull/451 — fixes cache key, adds unit tests, and a stress integration test
Yara: thank you — can we backfill a canary plan? re-run canary behind feature flag with per-tenant load until metrics stable
Kevin: plan: 1) revert (done) 2) merge fix + tests 3) deploy to staging + run stress test 4) ramp 1% -> 5% -> 20% with telemetry gating 5) sign-off
Yara: I've added the gating dashboard tile to REDWOOD-CONSOLE -> Prefetch -> Tenant Isolation
Sam: also add a quick telemetry badge in console that shows cross-org leak rate next to rollouts
Kevin: owners: Olga (fix/PR), Maria (tests & audit), Sam (repro + integration harness), Yara (telemetry + gating), Kevin (release approval)
Yara: thanks all. tagging security for FYI: @security-team this is tenant isolation bug, low blast radius but needs postmortem
Maria: small note — we should run a db-query to find any other mismatched rows that might have been surfaced, coordination with support
Sam: creating a short reproduction gist and attaching to ENG-7890
Olga: will monitor logs and metrics for 2 hours post-rollback and report back here
Kevin: great. if anyone sees unexplained org-owned data in other channels ping me immediately :lock:
Yara: closing loop — will write short postmortem after we've validated staging ramp
